doc: THE STD GUARD, above it: low 20 and slope 10 on 64x64 keep only the modes of radius 20 to 45 with an amplitude radius^-5 (3e-7 down to 5e-9), so the field BEFORE normalization has a population std of 8.9e-8 (tiny but not zero). The guard max(std, 1e-12) must not touch it: the output has std exactly 1 (a guard of 1e-6 would give 0.09, one of 1e-7 would give 0.9). Never reached by the shipped parameters (low <= 12, slope <= 3); it pins the guard as a floor at 1e-12 and nothing larger. The white noise the seed draws is the input plan0.white (size, size). FFT convention: numpy fft2 unnormalized forward, ifft2 divides by size^2, k = fftfreq(size) * size. Measured: max |diff| 1.8e-15 (4.4e-13 relative on values above 1e-3; scipy.fft 1.3e-15): the filter is applied to the spectrum, so the tiny amplitude costs no relative accuracy. 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute.
